_about: Every public-domain Robert Murray M'Cheyne (1813-1843, St Peter's, Dundee) prose text the Word Hoard holds. His hymns and poems are not shelved here: see the hymn manifest. Bonar's Memoir and Remains (Gutenberg 15251 and the 1844/1878 IA editions) and the Narrative of a Mission of Inquiry to the Jews are already on the Andrew Bonar shelf, recorded under _held. New here: The Works (New York: Robert Carter, 1847, 2 vols), the Additional Remains (1849 printing), the Familiar Letters (1848, ed. his father Adam M'Cheyne) and The Sermons (1863), all Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted. No CCEL M'Cheyne exists (ccel.org/ccel/mcheyne returned 404 on 2026-10-02) and Gutenberg has only Bonar's Memoir.

mcheyne-works-1847-1: The Works of the Late Rev. Robert Murray McCheyne (New York: Robert Carter, 1847), vol. 1
mcheyne-works-1847-2: The Works of the Late Rev. Robert Murray McCheyne (New York: Robert Carter, 1847), vol. 2
mcheyne-familiar-letters-1848: Familiar Letters by the Rev. Robert Murray M'Cheyne, ed. Adam M'Cheyne (1848)
mcheyne-sermons-1863: The Sermons of the Rev. Robert Murray McCheyne (1863)
mcheyne-additional-remains-1849: Additional Remains of the Rev. Robert Murray M'Cheyne (1849 printing, microform scan)
